# अहमेदी सैलून · Ahmedi Salon

> An always-on, synchronised street-corner radio playing 90s Bollywood film songs, inspired by Deluxe Salon.

Ahmedi Salon is a full-stack, self-hostable radio station. Everyone tuned in at
the same moment hears the same track at the same position, like a real station —
a server-driven station clock seek-syncs every listener. Audio is streamed
through YouTube's embedded player; nothing is hosted here, and all rights to
the music, films and recordings remain with their owners.

- Live: https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in
- Source: https://github.com/nabilaameena/Ahmedi-Salon
- Built by Nabil: https://nabilahmed.in
- License: MIT

## Sections
- [On Air](https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in/): the synchronised station; four rotations auto-picked by the hour in India (IST)
- [Songs](https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in/#/songs): 133 songs (1986–2001) with Hindi + Romanised titles, film, artist, year
- [Playlists](https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in/#/playlists): four rotations — Highway Raat, Saloon Classics, 90s Dard, Shaadi & Sunday
- [Listener wall](https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in/#/wall): live chat broadcast to everyone tuned in
